abi.calling_convention: Open Watcom 1.9 small-model near register call
abi.stack: valid caller near-return stack; wrapper uses at most 22 additional bytes excluding firmware interrupt frame and firmware stack
abi.success: AX=0 means the validated firmware request returned; display success is independently observed

character_policy.bottom_row: inherited firmware scrolling; qualification required, no replacement scrolling implementation
character_policy.carriage_return: return to first logical column without changing logical row
character_policy.line_feed: advance logical row preserving logical column
character_policy.unsupported: reject without BIOS call or cursor mutation
character_policy.wrap: inherited firmware logical row boundary; distinct from renderer raster width

mechanism.pointer: DS:SI points to one byte followed by NUL in caller stack

preconditions: accepted M08 kernel-entry ownership and valid MZ stack
inherited nonzero firmware vector and valid display state
inherited BIOS ROM-bank and interrupt-controller operational state; per-call bank and mask restoration required
firmware handler returns within externally bounded qualification
private qualification proves firmware stack use within owned reserve
readiness: missing vector rejected; no invented firmware status or polling timeout recovery
scope: early ASCII output only; no input, NLS, ANSI or machine initialization
